title: ReviewQualification
description: One run of the reviewer qualification suite (D56; P31; docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md): the reviewer route that ran it, the digests of the prompt template and of the suite it ran, each case's expected and returned verdict with its D55 review report's digest, and the score. Committed under fixtures/m1/review-qualification/records/; internal/qualify.Check reads it, and the route is qualified only when its latest record (by ran_at) has the current route, prompt, adapter and suite digests, every report agrees with it, and the score meets the suite's bar (all planted defects no_go, at least three of four clean controls go). The record holds no prompt, diff or reviewer text.

adapter_digest.description: internal/qualify.AdapterDigest: the http-chat adapter's source, package.json and the workspace lockfile, and the reviewer's limits (Opus #306 M6): any change makes the record stale.

suite_digest.description: internal/qualify.Suite's digest: suite.json (each case's rendered prompt digest included), every case's patch and every sealed file.

QualifiedRoute.description: The registry's reviewer executor the run went through, by its identity: a change to any field is another route.

prompt_digest.description: The digest of the case's rendered review.Prompt, as suite.json pins it (Opus #306 M2).

decision.description: The reviewer's typed decision; none when it returned none or one internal/review.Parse refuses (a miss).

report_digest.description: The case's adc.review-report/v1 (internal/review.Report), committed beside the record.
